name: 合同收款全量
description: 收款单带合同与计划三表联查，expense_no 向财务推送
statement: SELECT rv.id AS id, rv.receive_no AS receive_no, rv.contract_no AS contract_no, rv.receive_type AS receive_type, rv.receive_amount AS receive_amount, rv.receive_date AS receive_date, rv.payer_name AS payer_name, rv.voucher_no AS voucher_no, rv.receive_status AS receive_status, rv.expense_no AS expense_no, c.contract_name AS contract_name, c.project_no AS project_no, c.sign_unit AS sign_unit, c.handle_dept AS handle_dept, rp.plan_no AS plan_no, rp.period_name AS period_name, rp.plan_amount AS plan_amount FROM contract_receive rv LEFT JOIN contract_main c ON c.contract_no = rv.contract_no LEFT JOIN contract_receive_plan rp ON rp.plan_no = rv.plan_no
sql: SELECT rv.id AS id, rv.receive_no AS receive_no, rv.contract_no AS contract_no, rv.receive_type AS receive_type, rv.receive_amount AS receive_amount, rv.receive_date AS receive_date, rv.payer_name AS payer_name, rv.voucher_no AS voucher_no, rv.receive_status AS receive_status, rv.expense_no AS expense_no, c.contract_name AS contract_name, c.project_no AS project_no, c.sign_unit AS sign_unit, c.handle_dept AS handle_dept, rp.plan_no AS plan_no, rp.period_name AS period_name, rp.plan_amount AS plan_amount FROM contract_receive rv LEFT JOIN contract_main c ON c.contract_no = rv.contract_no LEFT JOIN contract_receive_plan rp ON rp.plan_no = rv.plan_no
